description:
## Problem (observed by an independent reviewer of PR #2638; verified by reading, not by exploit)
The trust-paths item moved corroboration into `benchbox/platforms/base/tuning_trust.py` and listed it plus the core tuning files in `.github/soundness-paths.txt`. Remaining trust-relevant code is still outside the manifest:
- the `get_tuning_introspector` overrides (`benchbox/platforms/duckdb.py` ~547, `benchbox/platforms/clickhouse/adapter.py` ~138, `benchbox/platforms/snowflake.py` ~1913), which choose the introspector and so can decide whether a run earns `applied_verified`;
- the apply-phase status in `benchbox/platforms/base/adapter.py` (~995, also the read-back's fallback) and the failure-path attach call (~1019);
- the DataFrame ledger status and attach (`benchbox/platforms/dataframe/tuning_mixin.py` ~249, `benchmark_mixin.py` ~603).
Two test gaps: nothing asserts `run_enhanced_benchmark` goes through `tuning_trust.read_back_applied_ledger`, so moving the logic back inline passes every test; and the manifest glob `benchbox/platforms/*_introspection.py` also matches files in subdirectories (`fnmatch` `*` matches `/`), while the pin test uses `Path.glob`, which does not. The docs section reads as if the surface is fully gated.

## Change
- Extract the remaining status-deciding code into gated modules or list the files, without making all of `adapter.py` a soundness path.
- Add a test that pins the read-back call site.
- Make the pin test use the same matcher as the real rule, and say in the docs what is and is not gated.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- Behaviour-identical extraction; the existing tuning suites pass unchanged.
- The PR needs its own external `Soundness review:` (or the stand-in attestation).

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow.
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`; then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`. Re-read every anchor before editing.
